text:
A: Hello! Hello, can you hear me?
B: Yeah. Hi, I'm Ioana.
A: Agnieszka. Or Aga, it's easier. Where are you, Ioana?
B: North West London. Burnt Oak.
A: I'm Yeovil, Somerset. I'm care assistant, senior, in a care home. And you?
B: Lettings admin. Estate agent's.
A: Ah, okay. Is that from Romania, your name? I saw an icon on your wall in the photo, I thought maybe Romanian or Orthodox.
B: Yeah, both. You're the second person today who's asked about the icon.
A: [laughs] Sorry! It's because we notice. I'm Polish, Catholic. We see a cross or icon and we think, okay, she will understand.
B: That's fair. Where in Poland?
A: Rzeszów. South-east, near Ukraine border, near the mountains. You?
B: Cluj. I came here at eleven.
A: Eleven, wow. I was twenty-two. So you are basically London girl.
B: Kind of. My accent is. My mum still talks to me in Romanian though.
A: Mine also, my mum. I call her four times a week, we cook together on video. She is in Poland, I'm here looking after other people's mums. Sometimes I think it's a bit funny. Not funny, you know, strange.
B: Yeah. My grandmother's in Cluj. I try and go every year or two, but flights and everything.
A: Which airport?
B: Luton. Wizz Air. I get there about three hours early, because airports stress me out.
A: Three hours! I thought I was bad. I go from Bristol, I make a list, I check my passport maybe ten times in the car. Mark, my husband, he says, "Aga, it's still there."
B: [laughs] Liam says that. And then I check again.
A: Do you cook Romanian food? I love sarmale, there was a Romanian lady at my work, she brought them once.
B: At Christmas, yeah. My mum's are better than mine. In the week it's just normal stuff, stir fries. I do the Lidl shop on a Sunday with a list.
A: Aldi for me. And the prices now! Every week something is more.
B: Lidl's got so expensive. I've started looking at the price per kilo on everything.
A: Yes, me too! We are the same, I think. Organised ladies.
B: Probably, yeah.
A: Sorry, I talk too much, yeah? You're very calm.
B: No, it's fine. I'm just quiet at first. You're easy to talk to.
A: Oh, thank you! That's nice.
